card.label: H.J.Res. 142
card.summary: H.J. Res. 142 is a joint resolution that disapproves and nullifies a District of Columbia law that had decoupled local D.C. taxes from federal tax law changes enacted in 2025. By overturning the D.C. legislation, this resolution puts D.C. tax law back in conformity with the federal 2025 reconciliation act.
